arguments.sql:
SELECT 'hdr' t, count(*)::text a, min("JRNL_NO")::text b, max("JRNL_NO")::text c, '' d FROM "GLJRNH"
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines', count(*)::text, count(distinct "JRNL_NO")::text, sum("DR_AMT")::text, sum("CR_AMT")::text FROM "GLJRNL"
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv', count(*)::text, min("INV_DT")::text, max("INV_DT")::text, sum("INV_AMT")::text FROM "APINVH"
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay', count(*)::text, min("PAY_DT")::text, max("PAY_DT")::text, sum("PAY_AMT")::text FROM "APPAYM"
UNION ALL SELECT 'hdr_post', "POST_FLG"||'/'||"SRC_CD", count(*)::text, min("POST_DT")::text, max("POST_DT")::text FROM "GLJRNH" GROUP BY "POST_FLG","SRC_CD"
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_stat', "STAT_CD", count(*)::text, min("INV_AMT")::text, max("INV_AMT")::text FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY "STAT_CD"
UNION ALL SELECT 'ctype', pg_typeof("CLOSE_DT")::text, count(*)::text, count("CLOSE_DT")::text, '' FROM "GLPERD" GROUP BY 2

SELECT 'unbalanced' k, h."JRNL_NO"::text a, sum(l."DR_AMT")::text b, sum(l."CR_AMT")::text c FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l USING("JRNL_NO") GROUP BY h."JRNL_NO" HAVING sum(l."DR_AMT")<>sum(l."CR_AMT")
UNION ALL SELECT 'hdr_no_lines', h."JRNL_NO"::text, '', '' FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'line_no_hdr', l."JRNL_NO"::text, '', '' FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'line_bad_acct', l."JRNL_NO"::text, l."ACCT_CD", '' FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" c WHERE c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_bad_vend', i."INV_ID"::text, i."VEND_CD", '' FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APVEND" v WHERE v."VEND_CD"=i."VEND_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_bad_jrnl', i."INV_ID"::text, i."JRNL_NO"::text, '' FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_bad_inv', p."PAY_ID"::text, p."INV_ID"::text, '' FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'hdr_bad_prd', h."JRNL_NO"::text, h."PRD_ID"::text, '' FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLPERD" p WHERE p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'hdr_date_outside_prd', h."JRNL_NO"::text, h."POST_DT"::text, h."PRD_ID"::text FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p USING("PRD_ID") WHERE h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_or_both', l."JRNL_NO"::text, l."DR_AMT"::text, l."CR_AMT"::text FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."DR_AMT"<0 OR l."CR_AMT"<0 OR (l."DR_AMT"<>0 AND l."CR_AMT"<>0)
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_multi_jrnl', i."JRNL_NO"::text, count(*)::text, '' FROM "APINVH" i GROUP BY i."JRNL_NO" HAVING count(*)>1
UNION ALL SELECT 'ref_jrnl', h."JRNL_NO"::text, h."REF_JRNL_NO"::text, h."MEMO" FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 100
